results.title: Foodmandu company overview
results.snippet: Foodmandu is one of the oldest online food delivery platforms in Nepal, founded around 2010 and based in Kathmandu. It partners with restaurants mainly in the Kathmandu Valley and some other cities.

results.title: Pathao Nepal services
results.snippet: Pathao, originally a Bangladeshi ride-hailing company, operates in Nepal offering rides, food delivery (Pathao Food), and parcel services through a single app.

results.title: Digital payments in Nepal
results.snippet: Digital wallets such as eSewa and Khalti have grown in Nepal, making online ordering easier, although cash on delivery remains common.

results.title: Challenges for delivery businesses in Nepal
results.snippet: Common challenges include traffic congestion, inconsistent addressing systems, high rider costs, and concentration of demand in urban areas such as Kathmandu, Lalitpur, Bhaktapur and Pokhara.
